mapper.insert: insert into golf_tournaments (id, contest_id, name, course, starts_at, ends_at) values ( #{tournament.id}, #{tournament.contestId}, #{tournament.name}, #{tournament.course}, #{tournament.startsAt}, #{tournament.endsAt} )
mapper.update: update golf_tournaments set contest_id = #{tournament.contestId}, name = #{tournament.name}, course = #{tournament.course}, starts_at = #{tournament.startsAt}, ends_at = #{tournament.endsAt} where id = #{tournament.id}
mapper.insert: insert into golf_tournament_results (tournament_id, golfer_id, finish_position, prize_money) values (#{result.tournamentId}, #{result.golferId}, #{result.finishPosition}, #{result.prizeMoney})
mapper.sql: select GT.id tournamentId, GT.contest_id tournamentContestId, GT.name tournamentName, GT.course tournamentCourse, GT.starts_at tournamentStartsAt, GT.ends_at tournamentEndsAt from golf_tournaments GT
select TR.tournament_id resultTournamentId, TR.golfer_id resultGolferId, TR.finish_position resultFinishPosition, TR.prize_money resultPrizeMoney from golf_tournament_results TR
mapper.select: where GT.contest_id = #{contestId} order by GT.starts_at, GT.id
where TR.tournament_id = #{tournamentId} order by TR.finish_position is null, TR.finish_position, TR.golfer_id
